name: Zenduty
summary: Zenduty, now branded Xurrent IMR, lists Starter at $6 and Growth at $16 per user a month with a 14-day trial. The page does not say whether those figures assume yearly billing, so treat them as list prices to confirm.

facts.text: The pricing page says every plan includes scheduling, escalation policies, postmortem templates, alert rules by priority, service or team, and single sign-on.
The page offers a Bill Yearly toggle labeled Save 16%, and it does not state which price is shown when the toggle is off.
Starter allows up to 5 seats and Growth up to 50, and Enterprise is quoted on request.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Up to 5 seats and 1 team. The page does not say whether this assumes yearly billing

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Up to 50 seats and 5 teams. The page does not say whether this assumes yearly billing

hiddenCosts: The yearly billing toggle saves 16%, but the page does not show which of the two prices the figures above represent.
